prompt: Review this Laravel code: `foreach(User::all() as $user) { echo $user->posts->count(); }`
expected: Identify the N+1 query issue. Recommend eager loading the posts relationship using `User::with('posts')->get()`.
actual: I noticed an N+1 query vulnerability in your loop. When you iterate over `User::all()` and access `$user->posts`, Laravel lazily executes a new query for the posts of each user. To resolve this, you should eagerly load the posts relationship before looping: `foreach(User::with('posts')->get() as $user) { ... }`.

prompt: I need to write a background job to send an email to a User. I'm passing the User model to the constructor. What do I need to be careful about?
expected: Warn about serializing models as IDs which may fetch stale or deleted data when the job processes.
actual: When you pass an Eloquent model to a queued job constructor, Laravel serializes it using its ID. When the queue worker eventually picks up the job to process it, it re-fetches the model from the database. Be careful because the model data might have changed or even been deleted in the time between dispatching the job and processing it.
